---
title: "Smooth Tool Options Widget"
format: html
---

## Overview

`SmoothToolOptions_Widget` is the options-bar page shown when `MediaToolId::Smooth` is active in the Media Viewer left tool strip. It configures the hover-circle radius and local smoothing algorithm for brush-based edits on the selected line.

## Controls

| Control | State field | Description |
|---------|-------------|-------------|
| Brush size slider / spinbox | `SmoothToolPrefs::radius_px` | Hover circle radius in scene pixels (1–50, default 10) |
| Algorithm combo | `SmoothToolPrefs::algorithm` | `MovingAverage` or `PolynomialFit` |
| Strength slider / spinbox | `SmoothToolPrefs::strength` | Moving-average passes (1–3, enabled for Moving Average only) |
| Order spinbox | `SmoothToolPrefs::polynomial_order` | Polynomial order (1–8, enabled for Polynomial Fit only) |

## Behavior

When the Smooth tool is active:

- Left-click drag on a **selected line** smooths vertices within the hover circle.
- Smoothing is continuous during drag, matching the Eraser tool interaction model.
- Endpoints outside the brush are preserved for moving-average smoothing.

`Media_Widget::_syncBrushHoverCircle()` enables the shared `Media_Window` hover circle and applies `SmoothToolPrefs::radius_px`.

## Related Code

| Component | Role |
|-----------|------|
| `MediaLine_Widget::_smoothPointsInLine` | Mutates the selected line via `smoothPolylineLocally` |
| `LineEditOperations` | Qt-free local smoothing and polynomial-fit helpers |
| `Media_Window::setShowHoverCircle` / `setHoverCircleRadius` | Shared hover-circle rendering |
